name: dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.feed
title: Catalog Feed
description: Catalog feed extension. Extends `dev.ucp.common.feed` with a record type: the records of a catalog feed are catalog Product objects with nested variants, the same records Catalog Search returns. Catalog Search and Lookup remain authoritative at serving time. A catalog feed manifest carries `filters`, in the Catalog Search filter vocabulary. Discovery, feed lists, manifests, files, and snapshot semantics are defined by the Feed capability.

dev.ucp.common.feed.title: Catalog Feed Manifest
dev.ucp.common.feed.description: Feed manifest whose records are catalog Products. Adds `filters` to the manifest, using the Catalog Search filter vocabulary.

filters.description: Row-inclusion predicates the Business applied when generating this snapshot, using the same names and semantics as Catalog Search filters. Absent means no filter was applied.
